notes.title: PLAYISM to be the Publisher for 34EVERLAST! Aiming for a 2024 Release
notes.notes:
How many times do I have to end the world before I can see you again?

PLAYISM is proud to be the publisher for 34EVERLAST, a super-condensed action adventure where you challenge fate through repeated playthroughs.

Please wishlist the game to stay updated!
